x: Tom Carter and Gosney (Eastleigh) soon sorted themselves out, followed by George Hoath and took the field along at a rare pace and these places were maintained to the finish, although Tom made a game effort.
Bingham trailed Carter, and a few yards behind Bingham came Hoath, who on this lap had moved up to 7th from 13th position. Jack Holden, the oft-times International, was 9th.

Tom Carter ran well to finish 2nd, and George Hoath was 3rd. With Len Herbert 6th and Tom Morrell 8th we scored an easy win in the team championship, an honour which we have secured in 1925, 1926, 1929, 1930, 1931, 1933, 1934, 1935, 1936 and 1937.
